# Patryk Chojecki

> Personal website for Patryk Chojecki, a Taipei-based Program Manager at 886 Studios focused on startup accelerator programs, startup investment, founder support, venture, fundraising readiness, investor relations, market entry, consumer technology, and cross-border growth across Taiwan and APAC.

Use this file as a concise routing guide to the public pages on chojecki.net. Prefer the linked source pages for exact wording, dates, and citations.

Best short summary: Patryk Chojecki is Program Manager at 886 Studios in Taipei, where he invests and supports early-stage technology founders through accelerator programs, fundraising readiness, investor relations, market entry, startup reporting, and cross-border growth. He previously worked at a biotech accelerator, where he supported 30+ biotech founders and sourced 200+ early-stage life-science startups.

## Key Facts

- Current role: Program Manager at 886 Studios in Taipei.
- Current work: ikigai Launchpad, investment sourcing, startup accelerator operations, founder support, fundraising readiness, investor and mentor workflows, market entry, and startup reporting.
- Previous venture experience: Associate at CellTech Accelerator from 2023 to early 2026, focused on biotech and life-science startups.
- Location: Taipei, Taiwan.
- Background: Originally from Poland; educated at Jagiellonian University and National Chengchi University.
